purpose: Numeric values expected to be extracted as structured facts. Used to validate Phase 3 rate-recomputation and CI-parsing checkers and to drive cross-document agreement tests.

expected_numeric_facts.label: primary_endpoint_response_rate_12_months
expected_numeric_facts.rationale: Pivotal study endpoint in CER body. Triplet (value, CI, denominator) all present in the same span. Anchors NT-001 cross-document agreement and recomputation checks.
expected_numeric_facts.notes: 412 patients is the denominator implied by 'in 412 patients'. The 'at 12 months' qualifier should be captured as a temporal modifier, not silently dropped.

expected_numeric_facts.label: adverse_event_rate_safety_population
expected_numeric_facts.rationale: Adverse event rate in CER body. Has denominator but no explicit CI. Anchors NT-002 cross-document agreement.
expected_numeric_facts.notes: Population descriptor is 'safety population (n=412)' in CER vs 'n=412 cohort' in source-study. Same n but different wording — a candidate for ECO-ALIGN if alignment is required to be lexical.

expected_numeric_facts.label: primary_endpoint_response_rate_table_cell
expected_numeric_facts.rationale: Appendix A table mirror of GOLD-NUM-001. No denominator or CI in the cell itself — only the bare value.
expected_numeric_facts.notes: Phase 3 should treat this as the same fact as GOLD-NUM-001 (table-cell mirror), not as a contradicting independent measurement.

expected_numeric_facts.label: adverse_event_rate_table_cell
expected_numeric_facts.rationale: Appendix A table mirror of GOLD-NUM-002.
expected_numeric_facts.notes: Same fact as GOLD-NUM-002, not an independent value.

expected_numeric_facts.label: primary_endpoint_response_rate_source_study
expected_numeric_facts.rationale: Source-study page 1 mirror. Same numeric value as GOLD-NUM-001 with different wording ('87.4 percent' vs '87.4%').
expected_numeric_facts.notes: Drives NT-001 (cross-document agreement should NOT fire ECO-NUM).

expected_numeric_facts.label: adverse_event_rate_source_study
expected_numeric_facts.rationale: Source-study page 2 mirror of GOLD-NUM-002. Same value AND same denominator. The CI 82.1-91.6 is reported on this page but it semantically belongs to the response rate (GOLD-NUM-001), not the adverse event rate — this is a known textual ambiguity in the seed fixture.
expected_numeric_facts.notes: The CI co-occurrence here is a TRAP for naive parsers. A robust extractor should NOT bind '82.1-91.6 CI' to the 3.2% rate on the same page. Surfaces as GOLD-FINDING-004 (ambiguous CI binding, malformed structure).

uncertainty_notes: GOLD-NUM-006 contains a deliberate textual ambiguity in the seed PDF (CI of the response rate appears on the same page as the adverse-event rate). Phase 2/3 must either bind the CI to its correct rate or refuse to bind it and emit ECO-MALFORMED. Silent mis-binding is the failure mode to catch.
